name: practice_report
description: Private learner-submitted reports about a practice task, retained for a future administrator review queue.

task_id.description: Verified owner task record referenced by the report

task_key.description: Stable task key copied from the verified owner task

roadmap_id.description: Roadmap associated with the reported task

week_plan_id.description: Weekly plan associated with the reported task

note.description: Optional short report detail, limited by the learner form

reported_at_utc.description: UTC time when the report was submitted

status.description: Administrator review state; new reports display as open
